won_reason: Competitive bake-off win + pilot data sealed the deal

calls.notes: Inbound lead — Deepak found us via LinkedIn. 850 employees across 3 plants. Pain: attendance tracking still on paper registers, payroll errors every cycle costing ~$8K/month in corrections. Evaluating 3 vendors. Asked for pilot.

Structured demo focused on plant floor biometric integration — our key differentiator vs greytHR. Deepak acknowledged our integration story was strongest. MD Sunita not yet involved. Proposed 2-week paid pilot at Plant 1 (280 employees), $0 risk.

Mid-pilot check-in. Pilot results strong: 0 payroll errors in 2 weeks vs avg 14 errors prior. Deepak visibly excited. Shared pilot report with MD — she asked for a meeting. Keka still in running but no pilot data.

Meeting with MD Sunita. Led with pilot data — 0 errors, 94% employee adoption rate in 2 weeks. She asked one question: can we handle PF/ESI compliance auto-filing? We said yes and demoed it live. She said proceed.
PO received. Deepak said MD appreciated that we came with data, not just slides. Annual contract signed for all 3 plants.

lessons_learned: Paid pilot turned into a proof — hardest objection handled with data
Plant floor biometric integration = key differentiator, lead with it
MD meeting with real pilot numbers = no price negotiation needed
Live compliance demo at MD level closed the loop instantly
Against free pilot competitor, our data beat their price
